title: Plan: strict-cold no-source thread-count sweep on current accepted DS4 route
purpose: Check whether current accepted vendor DeepSeek strict-cold route is leaving CPU fallback throughput on the table by using only -t 20 -tb 20 on a 61 vCPU AMD EPYC 7B13 host.

hypothesis.positive_case: If CPU fallback is under-threaded, increasing -t/-tb may reduce hot up/down fallback wall time without changing model bytes, page-cache accounting, or output semantics.
hypothesis.negative_case: If the bottleneck is page-cache major faults, O_DIRECT expert-pack reads, memory bandwidth, scheduler overhead, or per-expert small-chunk overhead, more threads may not improve eval token rate and can increase TTFT or contention.

hard_bounds.correctness_gate: France answer must be semantically correct and coherent; no top1-only promotion.

constant_config.prompt: Please introduce France in a short paragraph.

accept_reject_rules.accept_as_new_sota: Only if strict cold eval_tok_s > 4.4, TTFT <= 33617.688744 ms, memory_peak_bytes <= 16000000000 with file page cache counted, no swap/OOM, and France output passes semantic correctness. If accepted, immediately record full reproduction metadata, commit, push to ssd/vendor/deepseek-token-rate-16gb, then do a clean pushed-source reproduction.
accept_reject_rules.reject: Reject any run with lower token rate, TTFT regression beyond the gate, RAM/cgroup violation, OOM/swap, or incorrect/incoherent answer.
accept_reject_rules.do_not_claim_10: This sweep alone is expected to be a parameter check, not a source-ready 10 tok/s route unless measured strict-cold results prove it.
